metadata.question: Was there at least 35 millimeters of rain in areas of Wales and central and southern England on January 2, 2024?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use daily precipitation from CHIRPS (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY) for 2024-01-02 over two regions: Wales (approximate rectangle) and central/southern England (rectangle south of 54N, minus Wales). If empty, fallback to ERA5 daily (ECMWF/ERA5/DAILY), converting m to mm.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed for precipitation. Use binary mask for >=35 mm threshold to compute pixel counts over threshold.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: Check collection size (C1). Compute pixel counts; if zero valid pixels per region after processing (C2). Check for null/NaN or unreasonable values (C3). Otherwise, if both regions have max >= 35 mm, answer Yes (A); else No (B).
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    var dateStart = '2024-01-02';
    var dateEnd = '2024-01-03';
    // Approximate Wales bounding box
    var walesGeom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-5.8, 51.3, -2.5, 53.6], null, false);
    // Central & Southern England: broad box south of 54N, incl. SW England, minus Wales
    var engCsBox = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-6.5, 50.0, 2.0, 54.0], null, false);
    var engCsGeom = engCsBox.difference(walesGeom, 1);
    var unionGeom = walesGeom.union(engCsGeom, 1);

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    var datasetUsed = null;
    var precipImg = null;

    // Primary: CHIRPS Daily (mm/day)
    var chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')
      .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd)
      .filterBounds(unionGeom);
    var chirpsSize = await chirps.size().getInfo();
    if (chirpsSize > 0) {
      precipImg = ee.Image(chirps.first()).select('precipitation').rename('precip');
      datasetUsed = `CHIRPS (images=${chirpsSize})`;
    } else {
      // Fallback: ERA5 Daily total_precipitation (m/day -> mm/day)
      var era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5/DAILY')
        .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd)
        .filterBounds(unionGeom);
      var era5Size = await era5.size().getInfo();
      if (era5Size > 0) {
        precipImg = ee.Image(era5.first()).select('total_precipitation').multiply(1000).rename('precip');
        datasetUsed = `ERA5 (images=${era5Size})`;
      } else {
        console.log(`Dataset: None, Images: 0, Date: ${dateStart}`);
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }

    // 3. Processing and pixel count checks
    var regions = ee.FeatureCollection([
      ee.Feature(walesGeom, {name: 'Wales'}),
      ee.Feature(engCsGeom, {name: 'CSEng'})
    ]);

    // Compute mean, max, and pixel count
    var reducer = ee.Reducer.mean()
      .combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.max(), sharedInputs: true})
      .combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true});
    var statsFc = precipImg.reduceRegions({
      collection: regions,
      reducer: reducer,
      scale: 5000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });

    // Count pixels >= 35 mm
    var over35 = precipImg.gte(35).selfMask();
    var over35Fc = over35.reduceRegions({
      collection: regions,
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      scale: 5000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });

    var statsInfo = await statsFc.getInfo();
    var over35Info = await over35Fc.getInfo();

    function extractByName(fcInfo, name) {
      return fcInfo.features.find(f => f.properties.name === name)?.properties || null;
    }
    var wStats = extractByName(statsInfo, 'Wales');
    var eStats = extractByName(statsInfo, 'CSEng');
    var w35 = extractByName(over35Info, 'Wales');
    var e35 = extractByName(over35Info, 'CSEng');

    // Validate presence of stats
    if (!wStats || !eStats) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetUsed}, Images: 1, Date: ${dateStart}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Extract values
    var wCount = wStats.precip_count || 0;
    var eCount = eStats.precip_count || 0;

    if (wCount === 0 || eCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetUsed}, Images: 1, Date: ${dateStart}`);
      console.log('No valid pixels after processing.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    var wMean = wStats.precip_mean;
    var wMax = wStats.precip_max;
    var eMean = eStats.precip_mean;
    var eMax = eStats.precip_max;

    var wCount35 = (w35 && Number.isFinite(w35.count)) ? w35.count : 0;
    var eCount35 = (e35 && Number.isFinite(e35.count)) ? e35.count : 0;

    // C3 checks: null/NaN/unreasonable
    function invalid(v) {
      return v === null || v === undefined || !isFinite(v);
    }
    if (invalid(wMean) || invalid(wMax) || invalid(eMean) || invalid(eMax) ||
        wMax < 0 || eMax < 0 || wMax > 1000 || eMax > 1000) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetUsed}, Images: 1, Date: ${dateStart}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Percent >= 35
    var wPct35 = (wCount > 0) ? (100 * wCount35 / wCount) : 0;
    var ePct35 = (eCount > 0) ? (100 * eCount35 / eCount) : 0;

    // 4. Print concise evidence
    console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetUsed}, Date: ${dateStart}`);
    console.log(`Wales -> Pixels: ${wCount}, Mean(mm): ${wMean.toFixed(1)}, Max(mm): ${wMax.toFixed(1)}, Pct>=35mm: ${wPct35.toFixed(1)}%`);
    console.log(`C/S England -> Pixels: ${eCount}, Mean(mm): ${eMean.toFixed(1)}, Max(mm): ${eMax.toFixed(1)}, Pct>=35mm: ${ePct35.toFixed(1)}%`);

    // 5. Decision: at least 35 mm occurred in areas of BOTH regions
    var answer = (wMax >= 35 && eMax >= 35) ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```

Apply a reducer over the area of each feature in the given collection.
The reducer must have the same number of inputs as the input image has bands.
Returns the input features, each augmented with the corresponding reducer outputs.

Args:

  image (Image): The image to reduce.
  collection (FeatureCollection): The features to reduce over.
  reducer (Reducer): The reducer to apply.
  scale (Float, optional): A nominal scale in meters of the projection to work in.
  crs (Projection, optional): The projection to work in. If unspecified, the projection of the image's first band is used. If specified in addition to scale, rescaled to the specified scale.
  crsTransform (List, optional): The list of CRS transform values. This is a row-major ordering of the 3x2 transform matrix. This option is mutually exclusive with 'scale', and will replace any transform already set on the projection.
  tileScale (Float, optional): A scaling factor used to reduce aggregation tile size; using a larger tileScale (e.g., 2 or 4) may enable computations that run out of memory with the default.
  maxPixelsPerRegion (Long, optional): The maximum number of pixels to reduce per region.
